sv.title: Lundalärare varnas – ville bli ”slav” åt tidigare elev
sv.summary: En lärare i 30-årsåldern kontaktade en elev på sociala medier med sexuella anspelningar. Nu varnas han av Lärarnas ansvarsnämnd.

en.title: Lund teacher warned – wanted to be a "slave" to former pupil
en.summary: A teacher in his 30s contacted a pupil on social media with sexual innuendo. He has now been warned by the Teachers' Disciplinary Board.
